result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a food photo, which is the most visually broken element on the page.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar displays a broken-image placeholder icon (gray box with a crossed-out picture symbol) instead of an actual restaurant/food image.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image for this card or provide a styled fallback (e.g., brand color with logo) instead of the default broken-image glyph.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with its title truncated, which can look unintentional rather than an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient or peek spacing at the right edge to clearly signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure the title truncates with an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot with no text label or badge count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the dot indicator is announced or paired with a count.
